paths.description: Homepage and latest-video listing; represents catalogue/listing template and global chrome.
Representative video detail/player page; covers metadata, media, related content and player template.
Advertised video-removal journey; highest-risk form/redress path.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not respond to the user’s colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in size to the normal capture, the computed colorScheme is normal, and the stylesheet probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences and keyboard focus are not accommodated.
findings.evidence: The style probe found no prefers-contrast/forced-colors treatment and the first focused link computes to outline: none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add visible :focus-visible styles and forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations for controls and essential UI.

findings.summary: Navigation and menu state changes use abrupt swaps rather than view transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS/runtime probe found no view-transition rules or active animations across this multi-page site.
findings.suggestedFix: Use @view-transition { navigation:auto } for same-origin MPA navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The 14,072px listing offers no scroll-aware navigation or progress affordance.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured a 14,072px page; stylesheet inspection found no scroll-state query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide lightweight scroll-aware chrome or a progress/back-to-top affordance on long listings.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is entirely viewport-breakpoint based.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe counted zero container queries and exposed a large set of global viewport media queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards/search/navigation containers and adapt them with @container queries.

findings.summary: The prominent video-removal journey is a dead end.
findings.evidence: The removal URL renders no h1 and no removal form; DOM probing found only the global search form despite the page promising a privacy-removal request.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a clearly headed, labelled removal form with required evidence, status expectations, confirmation, and alternate contact route.

findings.summary: The removal journey provides no actionable state or recovery path.
findings.evidence: The representative removal page contains no request controls, validation, success/error state, retry, or escalation UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accessible validation, submission progress, confirmation/reference ID, failure recovery, and a fallback contact method.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow in the mobile Lighthouse run.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.0s and Speed Index 5.7s; the trace independently measured LCP 2.97s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail, reduce document latency, preload only the critical asset, and defer non-critical work.

findings.summary: Render-blocking CSS/font delivery delays first content.
findings.evidence: HAR identifies two very-high-priority parser stylesheets; Lighthouse estimates 1,060ms render-blocking savings and 550ms font-display savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical styles, use font-display, and shorten the critical dependency chain.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 52KiB unused CSS and 107KiB unused JavaScript; main.min.js is the largest HAR resource at 79,362 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific assets, remove unused framework features, and conditionally load player/form code.

findings.summary: Key controls and embedded content lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe reports an unnamed button; Lighthouse also reports unnamed links and an untitled frame/iframe. The search input has no label.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the menu/search controls, label search, add meaningful link names, and title embedded frames.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe reports five serious contrast failures including search, sort, pagination and all-items controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/UI.

findings.summary: Landmarks and visible keyboard focus are missing.
findings.evidence: axe reports no main landmark and 177 region violations; focusing the first link produces outline none and no box-shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/header/nav/footer landmarks, preserve logical heading order, and implement high-contrast :focus-visible rings.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables user zoom and video has no caption track.
findings.evidence: Viewport is maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=0; axe and Lighthouse flag it. The representative video has zero track elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions and provide captions or an equivalent transcript for videos.

findings.summary: Image markup and delivery have avoidable quality defects.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found one image without dimensions, all 41 without srcset, and seven legacy-format images; Lighthouse flags unsized and low-resolution images.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes, and correctly resolved AVIF/WebP derivatives.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and lifecycle blockers reduce platform robustness.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports four deprecation warnings, two BFCache failure reasons, and Inspector Issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated calls, resolve DevTools Issues, and eliminate unload/lifecycle behavior that blocks BFCache.

findings.summary: Some navigation links are unnamed or not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails crawlable anchors; the DOM probe counted seven empty-name links and ten anchors without href.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations and descriptive visible or accessible link text for every navigation action.

findings.summary: Security headers and session-cookie protections are materially incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent. PHPSESSID is neither Secure nor HttpOnly; three first-party cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP, HSTS and nosniff; mark session/auth cookies Secure, HttpOnly and appropriately SameSite.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced privacy and isolation policies are mostly absent.
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing; clickjacking is covered only by X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strict Referrer-Policy, least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and CSP frame-ancestors; consider Trusted Types for script-heavy surfaces.

findings.summary: An opaque third-party script runs during initial load without visible user value.
findings.evidence: HAR records a parser-inserted third-party script from vivodemisrentas.net taking 884ms; Lighthouse reports 18 third-party cookies in its run.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the opaque script or document its purpose, gate it behind consent where required, sandbox it, and minimise its cookies/data.

findings.summary: A high-stakes removal route fails as an empty/dead-end state.
findings.evidence: The removal route returns a styled page but no removal form or actionable fallback, creating the same outcome as a broken partial response.
findings.suggestedFix: Render an explicit unavailable/error state with retry, contact fallback, and preserved context whenever the workflow cannot load.

findings.summary: Arabic language is declared but direction is implicit and CSS uses physical positioning extensively.
findings.evidence: html lang is ar but dir is empty; captured CSS repeatedly uses left/right/margin-right/padding-left, making bidi reuse fragile.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare dir=rtl and migrate reusable layout rules to logical inset/margin/padding/block/inline properties.

findings.summary: The only discovered input is unlabelled and explicitly disables autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The search form probe reports no label and autocomplete=off.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a visible label or accessible name and allow suitable autocomplete/input assistance.

findings.summary: The privacy/account-adjacent removal flow is not clear or operable.
findings.evidence: The footer advertises video removal, but its destination has no removal controls, commitments, confirmation, or escalation route.
findings.suggestedFix: Make removal/account redress findable, operable, transparent about timing, and reversible/escalatable.

findings.summary: Image assets are not responsive or format-optimised.
findings.evidence: All 41 images lack srcset, seven loaded images use PNG/JPEG/GIF, and the logo lacks intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive modern-format variants, declare srcset/sizes and dimensions, and retain fallbacks.
